facts.tagline: Jas Leverette's dog training and behavior company, as seen on Netflix's Canine Intervention: evaluations, in-person training, board and train, and an online academy.
facts.contactOnly: Cali K9 trains dogs and fixes behavior in the Bay Area, Los Angeles, Miami and New York, and online. It starts with a 30-minute phone evaluation with Jas or Jay about your dog's behavior and history, which ends with a recommended program. Training programs are not priced on their site: call (510) 890-0298, email Training@calik9.com (they answer within 24 hours) or book an evaluation on calik9.com.
